description: Routing evaluation set v1 (AC 11, ADR 0045). Seven routes of labelled messages and a set of messages where no route should be chosen. Each route says whether its model is cheaper (down) or not (up) than the workspace default, which decides the threshold that applies. The harness splits each route's messages into examples and held-out tests at random, many times over. Written for Lakka in M3; provisional until calibrated against real traffic.
